brief.headline: Qualify a second source and push pricing toward ₹0.65–0.80/pc on caps, benchmarked to the market fair band

priceAsk.summary: Ask for pricing in the ₹0.65–0.80/pc range for 28 mm caps at higher volumes
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps sits at ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc; verdict is MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec — we want the lower end of that band

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 days after receipt; no concession without a price cut

brief.financialLeverage: Bprex publishes no financial statements, so we have no window into their revenue, profit, or how tight cash is for them. Our ₹63.21 L annual spend is meaningful but not huge. Without their numbers, we build our position from the market price band and from lining up credible second sources. Push firmly on price, but keep the relationship open — we need supply continuity and we can't see if they're stretched or stable.

evidence.point: We spend ₹63.21 L a year with them
Market asking price for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc
Industry verdict: MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec
HDPE resin import unit value stands at 87.61 ₹/kg, giving us a raw-material cost anchor
We pay on 30 days after receipt — not the worst terms we give, but no reason to ease further without a price gain

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B 65/100); pharma bottles, caps, preforms — top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health score B 73/100); pails, containers, pharma — strong and profitable alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: IVL Dhunseri Petrochem Industries Private Limited
alternates.why: Manufacturer lead in India-East (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ); maker of base materials for rigid packaging

risks: Bprex's financials aren't public, so we can't tell if a hard squeeze might break them or if they have room to move — tread carefully and keep dialogue open
Our ₹63.21 L spend matters to them, but we have no idea what share of their revenue it is — assume moderate leverage, not dominance
Market backups (Reliance, Srichakra, Chemco, Dalmia, Ganesha) are leads to qualify — none are approved or priced yet, so our fallback position is weaker until we qualify at least one
If we push too hard on price without a qualified second source lined up, we risk a supply gap on rigid packaging
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're spending ₹63.21 L a year with you on caps and bottles, and the market shows ₹0.65–0.80/pc is achievable at scale — let's talk about how we get there together while we also qualify a second supplier for resilience.
